daily_load_assessment: With a TSB of +3.41 (CTL 38.95, ATL 35.55), you are completely fresh and medically cleared for a high-intensity overload session. There is zero immediate fatigue carrying over from the previous days. Today is a green-light day to strike.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the past 3 weeks, you have accumulated 14 hours of training across 15 sessions, highlighting a stable baseline but a flatlining CTL trend. While your e-bike commuting provides a solid low-intensity floor, the lack of structured, progressive overload is preventing you from driving your CTL toward the target of 60. We must break this plateau by introducing highly targeted, uncomfortable intervals.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Your 180-day macro trend demonstrates a massive aerobic foundation built on consistent commuter miles. However, your top-end capacity (5-min cycling power and 5km running speed) is under-stimulated. To safely scale your CTL from 39 to 60 at a rate of +1 to +2 per week, we are strictly executing a Pyramidal 70/30 distribution. Your aerobic base is set; today we build the peak.
coach_verdict: You are fresh, fully recovered, and your TSB is positive (+3.41). Today is an absolute high-intensity priority day. I recommend executing Priority 1 (Cycling VO2max Intervals) to aggressively target your 5-minute peak power. If you must run, Priority 2 is your target. Priority 3 is reserved only if you cannot train outdoors or on a trainer.

priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 mins ramping from Zone 1 to Zone 3, including 3x 30-sec fast-cadence efforts. Main Set: 5 x 4 minutes at 290 Watts (Zone 5), with 4 minutes of very easy spinning recovery between each interval. Cool-down: 10 mins easy spin.
priority_1.reason: Directly targets your goal of improving 5-minute peak power. Your fresh recovery status (TSB +3.41) makes today the perfect physiological window to execute a high-intensity cycling overload.

priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 mins easy jogging, followed by 4x 100m progressive strides. Main Set: 5 x 800 meters at your goal 5km target pace. Rest: 2 mins walking/jogging recovery between reps. Cool-down: 10 mins easy jogging.
priority_2.reason: Develops running economy, anaerobic threshold, and pacing precision for your 5km target. This fulfills the high-intensity quality session portion of your 30% training distribution.

priority_3.session_title: Heavy Torque and Posterior Chain Strength
priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 mins mobility. Back Squats: 3 sets x 5 reps @ 80% 1RM (focusing on explosive ascent). Deadlifts: 2 sets x 5 reps @ 82.5% 1RM. Kettlebell Swings (20kg): 3 sets x 15 reps (snappy hip extension). Heavy Sandbag Carry (70kg): 3 sets x 50 meters.
priority_3.reason: Builds sport-specific torque required for cycling power transfers and the muscular resilience needed for running impact forces, utilizing your available gym equipment.
